title: Refuse a git commit --amend when HEAD is a merge commit or nothing is staged (candidate guard)
why:
Guard or check: yes. Queued per rule building-mistake-names-its-guard (queued as step:amend-guard-merge-head), proposed by the coordinator 02:45 CST Nov 15 (relayed).

Mistake: at 02:43 CST Nov 15 lane stood-pick-needs-review (PR #3472) ran `git commit --amend` with nothing staged. That rewrote the message of a merge commit. The lane soft-reset back to the pushed head: the tree was identical and nothing was pushed (lane report, relayed; triage read no reflog).

Harm: a merge commit's message was rewritten, unpushed and harmless this time. The rule it protects is shared-trees-no-destructive-git: an amend rewrites history in a tree other agents share.

Guard idea: refuse `git commit --amend` when HEAD is a merge commit or when nothing is staged.

Cull test (rule building-guard-needs-incident): the incident is real, one, and the harm was low. Keep the guard only if its false alarms cost less than the harm it stops. Cost is unmeasured: one read of HEAD's parent count and the index per amend. A normal amend (staged change, non-merge HEAD) must pass, and a test must show the guard red on the merge-head case first.

Triage read no code and no guard.

SIGHTING 04:04 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 04:02, relayed from lane spawn-model-below-role, PR #3493; the lane's words, unchecked by triage): the lane amended a pushed commit by mistake and says no guard stops that. Not the same case as the step's two refusals (merge HEAD, nothing staged): the lane did not say whether its HEAD was a merge or whether anything was staged, so whether the guard as written would have refused it is unknown. Incident two; harm unmeasured. A guard on amending a commit already on origin would be a wider check; a lane reads the case first.
source: Coordinator 02:45 CST Nov 15 (relayed): 'Proposed guard, queued as step amend-guard-merge-head: refuse amend when HEAD is a merge or nothing is staged. Incident: one, harmless, 02:43 CST (lane's report).'
note: Candidate guard; not built; owner coordinator; incident one, harmless.
